title: Use the trivial-edit floor in excess and detection and remove the borrowed-floor fallback
description: Replace ask-twice as the gender floor with the trivial-edit floor for every engine, and delete the fallback that copies an engine's largest ask-twice value from another task.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Flip rates now use the trivial-edit floor wherever an engine has answered it; Jev no longer uses a borrowed floor. Laya and Kev still use ask-twice until they answer. Released via PR #118.
